d.ko: FELLOWSHIP은 끝없이 확장되는 던전 모험이 특징인 흥미진진한 판타지 배경의 멀티플레이어 온라인 던전 어드벤처 게임입니다.
d.en: Choose your hero, form your group and battle through dungeons together in a Multiplayer Online Dungeon Adventure. Progress through Leagues, endlessly scaling Dungeons and chase new rewards with every fresh season. With a growing roster of Heroes and content there’s always something new in FELLOWSHIP
d.zh: 《秘境战盟》是一款多人在线地下城冒险游戏，背景设定在一个激动人心的奇幻世界中，拥有无限升级的地下城挑战。
